Barber |location =[[Filly]] |family = |TV actor = |stunt double= |special = }} The proprietors of the '''dentist/barber''' business are inhabitants of [[Filly]] {{in|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== In episode "[[The Head]]", when [[Maximus]] is one cap short to repair a part of his power armor, he visits the town's dentist and sells a tooth of his and earns the necessary caps to have his device fixed by [[Jamila]]. ==''Fallout'' experience at SXSW== While the dentists/barbers are unseen in the TV series aside from their establishment's signboard, two actual actors were hired for the role for a ''Fallout'' experience promotional event during the [[wikipedia:South by Southwest|SXSW]] festival in March 2024.[https://eu.statesman.com/picture-gallery/entertainment/2024/03/08/prime-video-fallout-sxsw-2024-photos/72899267007/ Welcome to Filly, a new SXSW activation promoting Prime Video's original series Fallout] - Austin American Statesman ==Behind the scenes== The names of the SXSW actors are yet to be identified. ==Gallery== File:Dentist-barber at SXSW 2.webp|thumb|The dentist/barber team at SXSW ==References== {{references}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Filly characters]]
